Question: Hazrat Saheb, I am facing very serious financial which hand to mouth,my embroidery business is very slow due to lack or order or running cash expenses,due to which I am not capable to run the running expenses of house.Also I have taken loans which is very problem for me to pay their monthly instalments and they are creating lot problem for me and making problem for me and my family.Pls advice me some powerful dua and wazeefas to overcome from problems asap,becausing due to taking lot of tension and under heavy depression my health is also effecting very bad.I hope you fully cooperation with me to overcome from these very serious financial problem and improvement in business and halal income from business.Thanks I request you pls advice me dua and wazeefas on my e-mail address asap. Answer ID: 8871 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2032/1882=D/1429) Recite the below dua after Fajr and Asr salah with durood before and after: أللھم اکفني بحلالک عن حرامک و أغنني بفضلک عمن سواک (2) Recite ya latif ( یا لطیف ) 1111 times with durood before and after, and pray Allah attentively. (3) Also, keep on reciting Salatul Hajah . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
